summary: Champion bot no longer issues a challenge when the challenged Personality's duel stat (Chi, Force or Personal Honor as the ability prints it) is higher than the challenger's; ties allowed. Switch BotContext.ChallengeGuard (on by default).
validation: New ChallengeGuardTests pass; full L5R.AI.Tests 196 cases pass (the michi-stall case passes when run from the repo root); format check clean.
remaining: Not measured in bot-vs-bot play against the previous champion; ChallengeGuard=false gives the old behaviour for a paired comparison. Duel modifiers beyond the table value are not counted.
